=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). 8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

You start with: You are seat 1. total 0. you know seat 2 total 0; seat 3 total 0. ante 1, best_score 0, bet_amount 0, bet_large 4, bet_small 2, board_cards 4, board_face_up_before_betting 3, board_up [], copies_per_rank 3, deck_size 18, first_actor 1, hand 0, hands 36, hole_cards 2, in_count 0, match_bonus 4, max_matches 3, num_players 3, pair_bonus 6, pot 0, ranks 6, second_actor 2, starting_pot 3, starting_total 0, third_actor 3, winner_count 0. still playing: 1, 2, 3.

Each round runs in this order: a new hand → the deal → the ante → your cards → first actor → second actor → third actor → response to the bet → responses and the final board → hand scores → the showdown → the totals → after the last hand.

Actions you may be asked for:
  first_actor  answer with one of: CHECK, BET 2, BET 4
  second_actor answer with one of the options you are given
  third_actor  answer with one of the options you are given
  response_to_the_bet answer with one of: CALL, FOLD

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.

2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.

=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). 1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. 8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). 8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. 1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.

=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. === Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 3, Curie. Seats are referred to by number.

Each round runs in this order: a new hand → the deal → the ante → your cards → first actor → second actor → third actor → response to the bet → responses and the final board → hand scores → the showdown → the totals → after the last hand.

  second_actor answer with one of the options you are given

  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. [user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).

1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. [user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). [user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). 8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.
